kind: authored guidance calibration cases and manual source-reading application

cases.request: Create a small one-screen card game with a large saved Control hierarchy and repeated card instances.
facts: The root owns one run lifetime and wires card requests.
Rules read one price value; presentation consumes that value.
Rearranging layout does not change gameplay rules.
cases.expected: Select cohesion review; a supported keep-combined decision is valid. Neither node count nor presence of UI requires extraction.
cases.manual_assessment: Keep combined: trace price/layout changes to the existing single authority and local presentation. Revisit when concrete independent behavior or lifetime appears.

cases.request: Change health display to add a localized suffix.
facts: Health display text supplies gameplay authority.
Localization changes the value subsequently parsed by damage logic.
cases.expected: Select responsibility review despite short code and apparently small UI edit. Correct gameplay authority/presentation coupling; a new scene file is optional.
cases.manual_assessment: Concrete finding: presentation formatting changes damage state. Store authoritative numeric health and render it; no automatic scene split.

cases.request: Assess whether moving Shop into its own scene solved overload.
facts: Main still reaches into Shop/%Price and Shop/%Buy.
Main charges UNIT_PRICE but duplicates a literal price in feedback and rendering.
cases.expected: Trace consumers and duplicated price changes; another tscn alone is insufficient evidence of separation.
cases.manual_assessment: Correct shared price authority first; extract presentation only if its interface hides the internal fields and removes demonstrated coordination cost.

cases.request: Change damage multiplier from 2 to 3 without changing ownership, composition or dependencies.
facts: One existing formula changes; UI consumes its returned value.
cases.expected: No new architecture review; perform affected behavior verification.
cases.manual_assessment: Cohesion is not selected. This request changes a value within the existing owner.

cases.request: Review the completed pilot against scene/controller cohesion.
facts: Main owns run state, combat, wiring and UI rendering.
Ten native slot scenes encapsulate card presentation and emit requests.
A price change must update UNIT_PRICE plus literal price copy in feedback and button rendering; saved placeholders also need an authoring decision.
cases.expected: Flag the concrete policy/presentation coupling. A compact pilot can retain its scene aggregation; do not require HUD/shop/footer extraction solely by count.
cases.manual_assessment: Keep aggregate scene for the pilot; record advisory pricing-duplication correction and presentation extraction as a revisit when its independent changes warrant it. Passing runtime evidence does not settle coherence.

cases.request: Approve the controller architecture from a screenshot and line count.
facts: The saved scene, script consumers and state owners are unavailable.
cases.expected: Record unassessed with the missing sources; do not invent a split or infer cohesion from passing import/tests.
cases.manual_assessment: Unassessed: actual responsibilities and a change trace cannot be established from those artifacts.

cases.request: Verify drag-to-merge through a native Control.
cases.expected: Useful payload/handler test, incomplete gesture coverage. Pair it with press, held-button motion, native drag-start assertion and release through the scene Viewport, plus nominated device observation.
cases.manual_assessment: Handler passes do not cover drag initiation; new branch selects the missing event-path evidence.

cases.request: Native tool drag fails, while complete engine-event drag passes.
cases.expected: Diagnose delivered event protocol in a controlled copy, retain failure, avoid product workaround, and require valid real-device or named human evidence before closing that observation.
cases.manual_assessment: Acquisition limitation supported by delivered events; synthetic success alone does not close visible drag evidence. Pilot human confirmation supplies the separate evidence.

cases.request: Check enemy preview after per-round stat scaling.
facts: Definition attack is 5 but combat uses scaled attack 3.
UI shows 5 ATK and 5/8 HP even though scaled maximum/current health is 5.
cases.expected: Select a non-default value case and compare displayed stats/max/current with actual gameplay values using an independently specified expectation.
cases.manual_assessment: Presentation mismatch: display authoritative live attack and scaled maximum/current health. Checking only authored defaults would miss it.

limits: Manual assessments are author judgments and are not an independent test of future model compliance.
Package/frontmatter checks and helper tests validate packaging and unchanged mechanics, not architectural quality.
